The '''Seventh Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the course of a [[Battle of Mustafar (Clone Wars)|battle on Mustafar]], the Seventh [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] supplied [[Gamble Squadron]], a [[Gamble Squadron|unit]] of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]], to a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi General]] for use against encroaching [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces under the command of [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]].

Later, following the [[Assault on the Arbitrator|defense of the ''Arbitrator'']] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the Seventh Fleet was called in to transport the crew of the crippled [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Arbitrator (Venator-class)|''Arbitrator'']] to the nearest [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]].
